       6.1 HSG - MAINTENANCE SCHEDULE


         MAINTENANCE


             Items                                       Lubrication                                                       Interval


               Inspect lubrication tank level.                ISO 68 oil for guide ways (e.g Mobil Vactra Oil No.2)               Daily


             Clean the filter inside the oil reservoir          ISO 68 oil for guide ways (e.g Mobil Vactra Oil No.2)               Biannually


               Inspect hydraulic unit level                  ISO 32 hydraulic oil (e.g Mobil DTE 10 Excel 32)                 Monthly


               Inspect coolant tank level                        Cutting fluid                                                 Monthly


           Note : New machines need to change the hydraulic oil in the hydraulic tank after the first 3 months. It is recommended to
         change the hydraulic oil annually after the initial change.

         Daily Inspection


                                            MACHINE STATE
               ITEM   INSPECTION ITEMS                          ACTION / VERIFICATION
                                                                     Off       On


                   1          Lubrication tank level             X                     Ensure oil level is above the limit line


                   2         Table speed control lever position     X                      Set to the lowest setting


                   3          Grinding wheel position           X                    Above work piece


                   4          Hydraulic unit Level              X                      Shut off


                   5         Cooling unit level                X                      Shut off


                   6          Spindle motor                  X                      Shut off


                   7          Grinding wheel cover             X                      Closed and locked


                   8           Electrical panel door             X                      Closed and locked


                   9         Running direction                        X          Clockwise


                   10       Warm-up                              X         30 minutes before full operation
